mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or consular authority in shareholder's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation / corporate excerpt of any non-French corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization (for non-Hague states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Statutory bylaws (statuts) and exchange of passports / proof of identity for each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Identity-issuing authority of the UBO's country of residence; certified translator for French version

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Civil registry of the founder's country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, managers, UBOs, and persons having effective control against TRACFIN watchlists, French national sanctions lists, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions, and OFAC SDN List where USD transactions or correspondent banking are contemplated. Enhanced due diligence is obligatory for PEPs under CMF Art. L.561-10 and for exposed families; negative screening results must be preserved in the AML/CFT file for at least 5 years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) operated by INPI, connected to the Registre National du Commerce et des Sociétés (RNCS); availability verified through the RCS/Greffe database via Infogreffe.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All constitutive instruments, including the name declaration, must be in French pursuant to Article L.123-1 of the Commercial Code and Loi n°94-665 of 4 August 1994. The corporate name may contain foreign words transliterated in Latin characters, but any foreign script must be transcribed into French in the statutes. The legal suffix 'Société par actions simplifiée' or 'SAS' must appear in full or abbreviated. The name must not be misleading as to the corporate object and must not infringe prior rights.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Greffe rejects the name on availability or conformity grounds, the applicant receives a motivated refusal. The applicant may file a request for reconsideration directly with the Greffe or, within 15 days of notification, lodge an application (recours) before the President of the Tribunal de Commerce in whose jurisdiction the registered office is located. The application must state the grounds and attach the refusal. Pending appeal, a new name application with a fresh availability certificate may be filed via the Guichet Unique. There is no administrative appeal to a government ministry; recourse to the judicial court is the exclusive remedy.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office cannot serve as the operational location for a physical grocery store; the retail premises must be a commercial lease or owned property open to the public. During pre-incorporation, the registered office may temporarily be domiciled with a licensed commercial domiciliation company (société de domiciliation) within France, but the subsequent physical store address must be registered and evidenced for RCS and food-hygiene inspection purposes.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 70% likelihood of an unannounced on-site inspection by DGCCRF/DDPP within the first 12 months for food hygiene, import-origin labeling, traceability, pricing, and store compliance; additional inspection risk from customs service for imported Asian foodstuffs.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce (French Commercial Code), articles L. 227-1 et seq. and L. 236-1 et seq. governing SAS formation and governance
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Acte de constitution de la société
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum capital of €1, no escrow account required for SAS
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
PRO FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION
The undersigned, being the sole shareholder of the proposed Société par Actions Simplifiée (SAS) named [Company Name], having its registered office at [Address], hereby resolves as follows:
1. The Company is incorporated with a share capital of 1,000 Euros (EUR 1,000), divided into 1,000 shares of 1 Euro each.
2. The initial share subscription is accepted: Shareholder 1 subscribes to 600 shares, Shareholder 2 to 400 shares.
3. The registered office is adopted at the above address, with the power to transfer it within the same municipality.
4. The following officers are appointed: President [Name], with full management powers; Director [Name]; and Statutory Auditor [Name] if applicable.
5. The Articles of Association are adopted in the form presented to the meeting.
6. This resolution is adopted unanimously by the sole shareholder on [Date].
This resolution constitutes the first board resolution of the Company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Drafting of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft comprehensive articles of association covering incorporation, capital, object, governance. Obtain electronic signatures from all shareholders. Submit online application with supporting documents.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If application is queried by the registry, provide additional information within 15 days or amend documents and resubmit

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Documents with Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via guichet-entreprises.fr
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload scanned or electronic version of filed documents. Pay any applicable fees. Receive acknowledgment and SIREN number immediately upon successful filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If rejected, correct deficiencies and resubmit within the statutory period

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal Officiel or BODACC (Bulletin Officiel des Annonces Civiles et Commerciales)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish the incorporation notice in the official gazette. Obtain publication certificate. This step may be automated upon filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If publication delayed, request expedited publication

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining SIRET and Bank Account Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for SIRET number using SIREN. Open corporate bank account with incorporation certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SIRET not issued promptly, follow up with INSEE

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with wastewater discharge limits (e.g., 100 m³/day) and VOC emission standards below 50 mg/m³ for retail facilities

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours (SDIS), structural load inspections, and workplace clearance from the Inspection du Travail

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), official portal impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French-resident SAS entities receive SIREN and SIRET automatically upon registration with the Chambre de Commerce et des Artisans and tax filing; foreign-owned entities register via impots.gouv.fr to obtain TVA identification number
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box elections; taxation at entity level under Impôt sur les Sociétés (IS) regime with limited options for micro-BIC regime for small businesses

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory facturation électronique via API for B2B transactions with real-time digital stamping (certificats de signature) and full clearance through impots.gouv.fr

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT on goods exported outside the EU upon proof of export; offshore services qualify under specific export criteria with reverse charge or direct zero-rating
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: 40% penalty on evaded VAT plus interest and possible criminal prosecution for fraudulent claims; retrospective clawback of zero-rated amounts

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), acting under the European Central Bank and the eurosystem framework, with foreign-exchange regulatory authority delegated under the French Monetary and Financial Code.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is a eurozone member with fully convertible current and capital account operations. There are no general foreign-exchange controls on current transactions, including profit remittances by non-resident shareholders, provided the distribution complies with French company law and the applicable tax residence/tax treaty requirements. Capital movements are free within the EU and subject only to EU anti-money-laundering and national security screening for foreign direct investment. Profit remittances are not subject to exchange-control approval, but French withholding tax may apply on dividends unless reduced or eliminated by the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive or a bilateral tax treaty.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no mandatory export-proceeds surrender requirement under French or EU law. Export proceeds may be retained in foreign-currency accounts or converted to euro freely. Reporting obligations are limited to Bank of France balance-of-payments surveys when monthly transactions exceed EUR 50,000 in aggregate, and to customs/statistical declarations for intra-EU and third-country goods movements.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational EUR Account
Capital Escrow Account / Operational EUR Account
Operational EUR Account and Trade-Clearing Facility

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium. Electronic-money institutions with a valid French or EEA passport (e.g., Qonto, Shine, or similar licensed EMIs) may provide agile operational EUR accounts and online payment rails. However, they are legally prohibited from offering credit or deposit products, and their capacity for non-EU remittance clearing and documentary trade finance is limited. For cross-border Asian supplier settlements and LC operations, a tier-1 credit institution is mandatory.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French banks apply risk-based KYC; remote video identification is permitted under French AML regulations if the bank uses a certified digital identity solution. In practice, however, corporate account opening for a new non-resident-owned SAS normally requires at least one director or authorised representative to attend a physical or notarised interview, plus delivery of apostilled corporate documents and notarised powers of attorney. A physical visit is strongly advisable during the inaugural onboarding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial owner with opaque corporate chain or high-risk jurisdiction nexus
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: UBO register extract or registered-agent certificate; audited financial statements; bank reference letters from existing financial institutions; passport copies; proof of source of funds; corporate org chart showing direct and indirect ownership; sworn declaration on ultimate beneficial ownership.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital contribution in foreign currency or third-party remittance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Share subscription agreement; notarised minutes of constitutive general meeting; SWIFT MT103 confirmation from originating bank; bank statement showing the same legal entity as sender; declaration of origin of funds; French notary or accountant certificate where applicable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Imported-goods trade flow inconsistent with retail grocery turnover
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supply or distribution contracts with Asian exporters; pro-forma and final commercial invoices; bill-of-lading or air waybill with customs entry numbers; French customs import declarations (DAU/ENS); warehouse or store-inventory records; tax-compliant VAT and sales ledgers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or adverse-media hits linked to shareholders or counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions-screening clearance certificate from a recognised screening provider; explanatory statement from legal counsel; documentation of delisting or appeal; names and details of ultimate directors; evidence of legitimate business purpose and untainted merchandise provenance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing requires a SWIFT MT103 with the precise French balance-of-payments statistical code for direct investment (e.g., code ‘Investissement direct’ on the Bank of France RFI declaration) and a narrative payment purpose referencing share subscription or shareholder capital increase. Funds must be credited to the dedicated capital escrow account opened in the SAS name. For shareholder loans, use a documented current-account agreement and code the transfer as a direct-investment loan; all balances above EUR 50,000 per month are reportable to the Bank of France.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements to Asian suppliers should use SWIFT MT103 for invoice payments, Documentary Collection (DP/DA), and Irrevocable Commercial Letters of Credit issued under UCP600 for bulk shipments. SEPA CT standard XML (ISO 20022) is used for EU suppliers. For third-country wires, the payment message must include the relevant International Bank Account Number (IBAN) or account number, SWIFT BIC, commercial invoice reference, and French VAT customs documentation. Payment traceability is enhanced by using bank payment obligations or MT199 pre-advice where required.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright forward contracts (FXForwards) against EUR/USD, EUR/CNY, EUR/JPY, EUR/THB, EUR/VND
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for currencies subject to convertibility or settlement restrictions
Cross-currency swaps for EUR-denominated funding versus Asian supplier currencies
Currency options (plain vanilla put/call) for the grocery import portfolio
FX rollovers and swap points for rolling short-term hedging positions

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Dépôt des comptes annuels (Annual accounts deposit with Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / INPI (electronic filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 8 months after fiscal year-end (e.g. 31 Aug for a 31 Dec close); court-ordered extension possible
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil penalty up to €1,000 under Article L.232-23; criminal fine up to €19,825 for legal representatives; 2-month registrar notice followed by administrative strike-off from RCS

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Déclaration de résultat – impôt sur les sociétés (Corporate income tax return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFIP) via EDI/EFI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year companies: 15 May of following year; non-calendar year: within 4 months after close (2-month extension on request)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing increase of 10% of assessed tax (40% if intentional), monthly late-payment interest of 0.2%, plus fixed €160 for non-electronic filing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises (CFE) – local business franchise assessment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFIP / Service des Impôts des Entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual declaration by 31 May of the year following the charge; payment by 15 December of the billing year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic 10% increase on late payment, monthly interest at 0.2%, additional 5% increase for a missing or inaccurate declaration; fiscal execution measures after tax notice

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (RBE) – update/confirmation upon any change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) / greffe
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after any change in beneficial ownership; no separate annual deadline if ownership unchanged, but annual confirmation at the time of the AGM is recommended
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: AML penalties up to €30,000 and 2 years' imprisonment for inaccurate/omitted beneficial owner declaration; additional civil penalty up to €2,000 per infringement

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory if at least two of three thresholds exceeded at year-end: balance-sheet total > €4M; turnover (net) > €8M; average workforce > 50; also mandatory when a shareholder holding ≥1/3 capital requests it
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général) under ANC Regulation 2014-03; IFRS optional for non-listed SAS consolidated statements and mandatory for listed groups

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No legal annual UBO filing unless a change in ownership occurs; but the company is obliged to file any modification declaration with the INPI within 30 days. At the time of the annual shareholder meeting, the SAS must review and update its Register of Beneficial Owners, recording 'aucun changement' when ownership has not varied.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Shares and Share Transfer Ledger
Directors' and Shareholders' Meetings Minute Book
Financial Statement Archive (signed accounts, management report)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$ 650–2,200 per year for registered office, local representation and corporate agent services (Paris and major cities in France)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$ 6,000–15,000 for voluntary statutory audit (commissaire aux comptes) of a small grocery retail operation; mandatory audits in the sector start near US$ 9,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard CIT; 15% reduced rate on first €42,500 taxable profit for SMEs (group turnover < €10M); 3.3% social contribution on CIT exceeding €763,000.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No sector-specific tax holiday. Available benefit: enhanced reduced 15% SME rate; indefinite loss carryforward (no statutory year cap) but annual deduction capped at €1M plus 50% of the excess.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Déclaration de résultats n°2065 (liasse fiscale) and schedules 2050–2059-G; filed electronically via impots.gouv.fr using GIGNO/EFI protocol (EDI or JSON streaming).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; with four quarterly CIT instalments (15 Mar, 15 Jun, 15 Sep, 15 Dec) and final balance at return filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For fiscal years ending 31 Dec: file by the second working day after 1 May. For other fiscal years: file within three months of the close of the period, unless administrative extension is granted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, form (SAS), head office, SIREN/SIRET, APE/NAF code (4721Z), corporate representative.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The local president of the SAS must be appointed; non-resident shareholders cannot sign the annual tax return as company representative unless simultaneously named as managing officer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net accounting profit before tax (résultat comptable) from the annual closing financial statements prepared under French GAAP.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This is the same result as posted in the 'Compte de résultat' filed with the Greffe; foreign parent adjustments do not alter the statutory books.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add-back of non-deductible expenses: excess vehicle costs, fines, personal costs, excessive management compensation, and provisions not recognised for tax purposes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Charges from foreign affiliates for shared services must be documented by contract and actual benefit; otherwise they are reclassified as constructive dividends.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Remove tax-exempt reserve, participation in employee savings plans, and the 95% parent-subsidiary exemption for qualifying dividends (if any).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only if the taxpayer provides a tax residence certificate and proves the foreign shareholder's real ownership for the dividend exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Carryforward of prior-year tax losses (déficit ordinaire), subject to the annual cap: first €1M deductible in full and 50% of the remaining taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Loss carryforward belongs exclusively to the French SAS and cannot be used against income of a foreign owner/branch; report separately in the loss schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed CIT at 15%/25% plus the 3.3% social surcharge; subtract quarterly instalments and tax credits; final balance payable on the same due date as the 2065.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure the foreign parent is not a resident of a non-cooperative state to avoid restrictive bars on deduction/withholding; the balance remains payable via the French bank account.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the annual return: automatic 10% penalty (40% if deliberate, 80% if fraudulent), late-payment interest of 0.20% per month (2.4% p.a.), a fixed €250 late return fine, and compulsory assessment procedure allowing tax reassessment without limitation.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 25% domestic withholding tax for non-resident corporations; 30% flat withholding for non-resident individuals; 0% under EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive if holding ≥10% for ≥24 months; treaty rates commonly 0–15%.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply a DTA rate, the beneficial owner must transmit a certified certificate of tax residence (Cerfa 5000) and, for individuals or hybrid entities, Form 5001/5002, to the French distributing company before the dividend coupon date. The company processes the reduction at source; otherwise refund is claimed by the beneficiary by 31 December of the year following distribution from the local Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: domestic withholding 33.33% (gross) if rights used in France; treaty rates commonly 0–10%. Interest: generally 0% for ordinary commercial loans; 30% for certain debt securities; 75% if paid to an entity domiciled in a non-cooperative jurisdiction. The EU Interest/Royalties Directive may provide full exemption where conditions are met.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Transfer-pricing documentation (Master File and Local File) is mandatory only if the French entity shows annual turnover (excl. VAT) ≥ €400 million or total balance sheet ≥ €40 million. Smaller entities must nevertheless complete the annual simplified transfer-pricing return (form n°2257-A-SD).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France has no dedicated domestic 'Economic Substance Regulations' but applies ATAD/anti-abuse principles and 'abus de droit' (Art. L.64 of LPF). The SAS must have real commercial substance: local inventory, sales staff, procurement decisions, and operational risk in France. A paper presence with outsourced management and nominal cash registers can be recharacterized as abuse and the tax base ignored.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate suppression of cash sales, use of e-cash registers showing understated turnover, or false import invoices from the Asian parent to reduce the local taxable profit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax recapture plus late interest (0.20% per month) and penalties up to 40% (bad faith) or 80% (fraud); criminal fine up to €500,000/seven years imprisonment under Article 1741 CGI.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The SAS president may be criminally sanctioned for 'abus de bien social' (Art. L.242-6 C. com.): five years imprisonment, €375,000 fine, and civil restitution to the company; under tax law the director may be jointly liable for penalties under a finding of false accounting.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the French SAS only as mailbox with no real local operations, using nominal intercompany management fees or routing sales through an offshore distributor to strip French gross margin.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Application of Art. L.64 LPF to disregard the arrangement and re-tax the French entity on re-determined profit; 40%/80% penalty; DAC6 disclosure penalties up to €100,000 for failure to report cross-border arrangements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil: director and controlling shareholder are jointly and severally liable for corporate liabilities (Art. L.651-2 C. com. in insolvency); individual travel ban and professional order sanction are possible when management intentionally caused the lack of substance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a grocery store without declaring beneficial owners, failing to report suspicious cash transactions, or accepting structured deposits of unexplained cash through the payment rails (POS/Interac, credit cards).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ACPR administrative fine up to €5 million or 10% of turnover; criminal money-laundering sanction up to €750,000 and five years imprisonment under Art. 324-1 C.P.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal fines and disqualification from management; if the corporate veil is pierced, the travel ban can be imposed and personal assets seized as proceeds of money laundering.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying dividends to non-resident shareholders without applying the 25%/30% withholding or using circular loans from the foreign parent to extract profits as falsely deductible interest instead of dividends.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterisation of the payments as dividends under Art. 111(a) CGI; additional 40% penalty and late interest; 30% withholding may be reassessed jointly against the distributing company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who deliberately omit withholding may be held personally liable under Art. L.262 LPF for the unpaid amount; French tax authority can serve a travel ban ('avis à tiers détenteur') against management and obtain temporary passport surrender during criminal prosecution.
